summary: Mega Matrix Inc. filed a Form 6-K to correct a typographical error in its 2025 Annual Report, where executive cash compensation was misstated as $101.6 million instead of approximately $1.02 million. The filing is a clarification and amendment, not a special situation event. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation category applies. The registrant is merely correcting a disclosure error and reaffirming its business strategy.
